metadata.description: Claude Code skills for product work rather than code — Figma files and product specs

plugins.name: fig
plugins.description: A bundle for a Figma file several people share. It builds your to-draw list before you start, draws each screen anchored to your file's own conventions, and keeps the canonical page current afterwards.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Product specs, the tasks that come out of them, and a daily record of the work — on local markdown files, with nothing else connected. Write a spec against a format and verify it; turn a request into a task's context table; keep a work log and turn a period of it into accomplishment statements. Notion or an issue tracker attaches through config when you want one.
